game.title: New England Patriots at Chicago Bears

lede: New England Patriots carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#6 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it PK with a fair total of 46.5 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is New England Patriots pass offence vs Chicago Bears pass defence, which sits +0.110 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
